title: Find Largest Value In Each Tree Row
statement:
Given the root of a binary tree, return an array of the largest value in each row of the tree (0-indexed). Return one maximum per level, ordered from the root level downward.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: root = [1,3,2,5,3,null,9]
Output: [1,3,9]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: root = [1,2,3]
Output: [1,3]
```

## Constraints

- The number of nodes in the tree will be in the range [0, 10^4].
- -2^31 <= Node.val <= 2^31 - 1
